title: Seven sectors from one rooted constants construction
description:

Seven sectors share one rooted Fold construction: electromagnetism, charged leptons, quarks, dark/baryonic support, Hubble calibration, Planck hierarchy and vacuum.

Maria Smith reconstructs a complete 16-field foundation vector and 26-field terminal vector from binary two, generator three, spatial rank three, boundary rank two and least cover depths five and seven. Fourteen common-order readings agree exactly across independent assemblies.

The paper gives every formula and intermediate sector calculation, the full exact vectors, all ten parent rows of the seventeen-node graph and explicit paths from One to all seven sectors. The original generator 3-to-4 test changes all twelve designated dependent fields while preserving all four held controls. Every comparison is displayed.

Terminal readings include inverse alpha 503846395469/3676744786, charged-lepton and quark product invariants, dark/baryon 279/52, Hubble 3305/3048, the 2^127 squared hierarchy and charged-colour transport, local vacuum floor 2^-20 and normalized cosmic magnitude 33/16. Each retains its original type, support and source order.

The complete 4,096-form grammar has one preserving construction. Native Lean 4 source, full program comparisons and an audit of 434 declarations with zero axiom dependencies accompany the paper. Original pure functions reproduce all eight certificate fields and match the retained native output exactly.
